conditions.note: Enforced by check-budgets.mjs — a report whose meta disagrees with any scalar key here is INVALID_CONDITIONS, not a comparison. t5/t6 measure the whole app group (every open window), so the window population is part of the condition. cargoProfile=dev records what these baselines actually measured: `make build-debug` is `tauri build --debug`, i.e. cargo's dev profile (opt-level=0, debug-assertions, overflow-checks). Reports taken before this field existed cannot be compared against these budgets — that is the correct outcome, not a regression.
